description: This file defines the PathWpf class, a snippet for drawing paths using WPF and PdfSharp. It contains methods that render various types of paths, including rectangles and pentagrams, using both PdfSharp and WPF PathGeometry objects.

classes.name: PathWpf
classes.description: A snippet class for demonstrating path drawing using WPF and PdfSharp.

methods.name: RenderSnippet
methods.description: Renders various path drawing examples onto the provided graphics context.
